notes: Borough adopted Resolution #36-2025 (January 21, 2025) setting Fourth Round present need at 53 and prospective need at 375 (lower than DCA's 412). NJBA challenged; mediation agreement April 23, 2025 set prospective need at 393. VLA (relying on approved November 2024 Third Round VLA) gives RDP=0, Unmet Need=393. Since 25% of adjusted prospective need (RDP=0) equals 0, no 25% zoning requirement applies. Borough proposes new Mixed-Use Development (MUD) Zone, increased borough-wide mandatory set-aside (15% to 20% for rental), HDCBC 100% affordable at Block 66 Lot 10, ADU ordinance, and Boiling Springs Gardens (142 senior units, HUD RAD) as unmet need mechanisms. Third Round RDP (149 of 656) was satisfied. Key Fourth Round overlay sites: AHO Zone (Block 24.03 Lot 33; Block 25 Lots 4/4.01/4.02/5 approved Jan 2025 with 5 affordable units), AHO-B Zone (Block 26 Lots 1 & 2/now 1.01 — completed 2021 with 30 affordable units), AHO-C Zone (Block 6 Lot 12; Block 8 Lot 10), MRO Zone (Block 29 Lot 3).
